$comment: Linked change management overlay (document 21, section 6.2; D-08). A one-row overlay: the operation is in patch.json.
It conflicts with nothing. A portfolio row may still narrow the mode in a client's working set (document 28, Q2); presets never hold portfolio rows (V44).

The linked-mode authorization fact follows document 28, Q22 (a working default the product owner can override). WORKING DEFAULT (open design question 12): the client-built step that reports the authorization state is a workload; it would hold its role through a workload grant (the proposed authorization-reporter role in Balanced).
label: Linked change management
description: Sets the change management mode to linked: the client's ITSM tool stays the system of record for change requests and their authorization.

setupNotes.text: Each change request holds the external change number and link from the ITSM tool. The ITSM tool's workflow is never copied.

Build a step in the ITSM tool that reports the authorization state with an evidence link. Where no step exists, the change manager confirms the external authorization on a confirmation card. A recorded number alone never counts as authorization.
